# Markdown Documentation Guidelines

## Documentation Standards
- Maintain consistent formatting in README files
- Use clear, descriptive section headers
- Document complex logic and configurations
- Create documentation for new features and changes
- Use Markdown syntax correctly
- Include code examples with proper syntax highlighting
- Use consistent link formatting
- Keep line lengths reasonable for readability
- Use proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3, etc.)
- Include table of contents for longer documents
- Use mermaid for any diagrams or flowcharts
